title: A Relaxed Maximum-Based Normal $S$-Iteration Method for Generalized Absolute Value Equations
summary: A relaxed maximum-based normal $S$-iteration method (RMNSI) is proposed for solving generalized absolute value equations (GAVEs). The method combines a maximum-based fixed-point formulation with a constant relaxation parameter and avoids the selection of an auxiliary matrix. Assuming that $A+B$ is non-singular, both stages require linear systems with the same coefficient matrix $A+B$, allowing a single factorization to be reused throughout the iteration.
